description:
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Rear Main Bearing Seal Set for the Suzuki 1.3L/8V G13BA Engine.
This is the Oil Seal for the rear of the Crank Shaft.
Made by SUZUKI
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Oil Seal 09283-68001
Qty 1 – Gasket 11349M60A20
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
